title: Prefixes un-, re- · The Water Cycle (intro)
goal: Read, spell, and use words with *un-* and *re-*; read a phrase-cued fluency passage on the water cycle at Model→Assisted→Independent; begin the Fry heart-word completion sequence.
review: none (first session of the level) — if coming straight from Level 4, warm up with 5 multisyllable words from L4.16's mastery check instead.
time: 30–45 min. **Materials:** paper, pencil; a way to time a 1-minute read (phone timer); audio playback optional for the Model step.
